question: How do memory retention cycles (retain cycles / strong reference cycles) occur in Swift closures and Kotlin lambdas?
model_answer: Retain cycles happen when object A holds a strong reference to closure B, and closure B captures a strong reference to object A. Neither object can reach reference count zero. Resolved by `[weak self]` or `[unowned self]`.
